services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Hello and welcome to the Coastal Angler Magazine January fishing report. This winter will bring some hot fishing in our waters. Sailfish, Dolphin, Wahoo, and Kingfish will be the offshore choice. When heading out, take a drive to the south and let the stream take you north. If you're just looking for Sails, try the 160' depth off the Dodge Wall. If you're looking for Kings, stay around 90' depth. Live bait will be the key to landing Quality fish and can be easily bought from your local bait boat. These guys monitor VHF 68. blurb: Guests spend the day deep sea or inshore fishing in the waters off Palm Beach, Palm Beach Shores, and Singer Island. The charters are private, with a maximum of 6 people per boat, and include fishing for species like sailfish, swordfish, mahi-mahi, snook, and grouper. Additional excursions include kite fishing, shark fishing, Bahamas trips, scuba diving, and boat parties.
